environment.import_method: projects saved by OpenUtau 0.1.565 after File > Open of M5 MIDI (A-series), plus the USTX wiki page

input.description: USTX structure of a tiny OpenUtau-created project

expected.summary: A description; classification is UNKNOWN unless a contract statement is established.

observed.summary: A saved project is YAML (UTF-8) with ustx_version 0.7 and resolution 480. Top-level: tempos [{position, bpm}] (ticks), time_signatures [{bar_position, beat_per_bar, beat_unit}] (positions in bars), expressions, tracks, voice_parts. Each track: singer (a string id, absent when none), phonemizer (a class name string), renderer_settings {renderer}, track_name, track_color, mute, solo, volume, pan. Each voice part: name, track_no, position, duration, notes. Each note: position, duration, tone (MIDI number), lyric, pitch (points), vibrato, phoneme_expressions, phoneme_overrides; no velocity. Legacy bpm, beat_per_bar and beat_unit remain at the root (the wiki calls them deprecated); tempos is the authoritative tempo list.

classification_note: The structure OpenUtau 0.1.565 saves matches the wiki's field descriptions; the documented version number lags the saved one (see C02).

details.tempo_representation: tempos list in ticks (authoritative); root bpm deprecated
